steps.content: As the darkness dissolves the submarine, you plunge into the cold, formless waters.
You failed to save Pylgia, and let her become a "monster."
The Abyss has turned your pain and regret into a trap to drag you down into its depths.
Was it when the monsters surrounded you, or was it the moment you chose to dive deeper...? Or perhaps, was it the first day you set foot in the DisSea?
